name: smh-mcp
description: MCP Server for Tencent Cloud Smart Media (SMH) - Upload, download, and manage files

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run clean && npm run build
scripts.publish:internal: cp package.json .package.json.bak && npm pkg set name=@tencent/smh-mcp && npm publish --registry=http://mirrors.tencent.com/npm/; mv .package.json.bak package.json
scripts.publish:public: cp package.json .package.json.bak && npm pkg set name=smh-mcp && npm publish --access public --provenance=false; mv .package.json.bak package.json

author: Tencent Cloud SMH
